summary: 28-year-old breastfeeding mother, 4 weeks post-partum, with a 4 cm tender fluctuant mass after 5 days of mastitis on flucloxacillin, fever 38.4. Ultrasound confirms a collection: ultrasound-guided needle aspiration (repeated as needed), antibiotics, continue breastfeeding/expressing.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Painful hot lump in the right breast while breastfeeding
inputs.hpi: Baby 4 weeks old, breastfeeding. Red painful right breast for 8 days; GP started flucloxacillin 5 days ago. Now a very painful swollen lump, fevers and shivers since yesterday.

exam.other: Right breast: 4 cm tender, fluctuant mass in the upper outer quadrant with overlying erythema; skin intact, no necrosis. Nipple cracked. Tender axillary node.

imaging.name: USS right breast
imaging.result: Multiloculated 3.8 cm fluid collection in the upper outer quadrant consistent with abscess; surrounding inflammatory change.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Right lactational breast abscess
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Lactational breast abscess (right), 3.8 cm on ultrasound, systemically unwell. Ultrasound-guided needle aspiration, send pus for culture, continue antibiotics, continue breastfeeding/expressing from the affected side.
